name: CSIR Nehru Science Postdoctoral Research Fellowship
funder: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Government of India
amount: Rs 50,000/month + HRA + Rs 3 lakh/year contingency (up to 25% for domestic and international travel)
other_rules: Indian nationals, PIO and OCI (up to 20% of awards to foreign nationals)
PhD within the last 3 years (or about to submit)
age limit 32 (relaxable 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, PwD and women)
must be sponsored by a CSIR laboratory
cannot be hosted at the CSIR lab of the PhD
notes: Applications accepted any time; selections usually in June and December by presentation and interview. 2 years, extendable by 1 for outstanding performance. Figures from the ISTI summary (updated 2022); confirm on csirhrdg.res.in.
